Method of Attack: Poses as a battery optimization tool to trick users into logging into PayPal app
Uses malicious accessibility service to mimic user clicks and transfer funds to attacker’s PayPal address
Runs overlay attacks on Google Play, WhatsApp, Skype, Viber, Gmail, Uber, Netflix, and several bank apps to phish payment card details and login credentials
Intercepts, sends, deletes text messages, accesses contact list, makes and forwards calls, accesses installed apps list, installs and runs apps
Impacted Systems: Android devices with PayPal app installed
Attack Vector: Malicious app installed from unofficial third-party stores
Enables accessibility service disguised as statistics activation prompt
Overlay phishing attacks on targeted apps
